newsitem.title: USA: D&N Financial unit offers preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: D&N Financial unit offers preferred stock.

text.p: D&N Financial Corp said Tuesday it plans to offer $27.5 million of noncumulative, preferred stock in D&N Capital Corp, a newly formed subsidiary that will operate as a real estate investment trust.
D&N said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1.1 million shares in D&N Capital.
Additionally, the underwriter, Roney & Co, would be granted an option to purchase up to an additional 110,000 shares of the preferred stock solely to cover over-allotments.
The dividend rate of D&N Capital's preferred stock will be determined by the company and the underwriter immediately prior to its sale.
D&N Capital expects to qualify as a real estate investment trust for federal income tax purposes, and as such expects that the preferred stock dividend will be tax deductible.

D&N Financial, a Hancock, Mich.-based bank holding company, said the new subsidiary plans to invest in mortgage loans on residential and commercial properties and to purchase the loans solely from D&N Bank or its affiliates.
The preferred stock of D&N Capital Corporation is expected to qualify as regulatory capital for D&N Bank.
